newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks fall by break on cabinet changes.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks fall by break on cabinet changes.

text.p: Worries about the stability of the Thai government following a cabinet reshuffle in combination with tighter liquidity prompted investors to unload stocks and drove the market down by the lunch break on Monday, brokers said.
"Liquidity in the money market was a bit tight this morning while investors at the same time thought that the cabinet reshuffle last week won't strengthen the government stability," a broker said.
The composite SET index lost 11.14 points to 612.11 on thin 833 million baht turnover by the lunch break.
Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh on Friday announced the cabinet reshuffle within his six-party coalition. The reshuffle has upset some of the ministers.
Liquidity in the money market was tight as the overnight interbank rate rose to 13-14 percent early from 12 late on Friday.
Most of the key sectors retreated by the break. The banking sector led the active list, losing 2.30 percent.
Bangkok Bank topped the active list, falling three baht to 165. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
